meta.units: measured / O: dx, dy, ds [m], dtheta, dphi, dpsi [rad]; dlength_m [m]; points [m] survey East, North, elevation; frames [m] MAD-X global X (North), Y (elevation), Z (East), w columns = local x, y, s
meta.frame: offsets in the device's ideal frame about its centre: x outward, y down (MAD-X; model -y = up), s along the beam. Applied = S x measured + O (overrides: helper_scripts/misalign.py).

BMAL3.note: BMA005-L3 sits inside the L3 vertical dogleg (DOG03_1, BMA, DOG03_2): 12 mm below the lattice, on purpose, following the beam's shift in the dogleg. Applied (user 2026-11-14): the dogleg runs at a constant current, so its bump does not scale with Brho; at low Brho the BMA looks like an unmisaligned element (the beam is lowered with it), at high Brho like a real misalignment. The dogleg itself is not in the lattice yet.
